title: RuneRouteBindingMatrix.v1
description: Rune-to-YGGDRASIL binding matrix. One row per declared ABX-Rune binding, each carrying an EXPLICIT reason for its resolution verdict. Adapted from the second attempt (Abraxas-v2.0 contracts/yggdrasil/rune_route_binding_matrix.v1.schema.json): that version keyed off a route concept this repo does not have, so only the invariant is taken — every binding states why it is or is not usable, rather than looking bound because a path was written down.

resolved.description: Rows whose operator path resolves to a callable.

unresolved.description: Rows that are not usable. total == resolved + unresolved.

by_reason.description: Count per reason. Every reason in the closed set is present even at zero, so a consumer can rely on the key set without diffing runs.

duplicate_rune_ids.description: Rune ids declared more than once. Must be empty: a duplicated id means two bindings answer to one name.

rows.description: Sorted by (rune_id, capability), so the matrix is byte-stable across runs.

capability.description: Declared capability id, e.g. RUNE.FIND_SKILLS. May be empty for a malformed binding.

operator_path.description: module:attribute, or empty when none was declared.

resolved.description: True if and only if reason == RESOLVED.
